execution.checkpoint: enabled with a 24-hour interval; no trigger in the timed path
execution.sample_order: Join, interval; no retries or extensions
execution.correctness: maintained EngineCase full-output oracle on every sample
execution.deadline_enforcement: every observation receives the remaining acquisition deadline through asyncio.wait_for; no further observation starts after expiry
execution.state_root_policy: new empty root for every warmup and measured observation; never reuse diagnostic, failed or per-observation sample-N checkpoint roots

cases.connection: multi-morsel state accumulation and one-to-one native Join production
multi-morsel run identity, cumulative index updates and interval output completion

unmeasured: ASOF, other row counts/types/modes, partitioned execution and remaining acceptance matrix
